verdict.rationale: Cursor documents Enterprise service accounts as non-human agent credentials. They can consume APIs, authenticate the CLI, and invoke cloud agents, with key rotation, revocation on archival and an audit trail. API keys also carry named scopes (e.g. admin:*), and CLI permission tokens restrict what an agent may do. However, the evidence never shows credentials themselves being narrowly scoped to least privilege for a given agent. missing for 10: documented fine-grained per-key scopes or permissions for agent credentials, least-privilege scoping outside the Enterprise tier, independent or hands-on corroboration.
